title: Welcome to Sauri
intro: Two steps are left: install the AI models that process your meetings on this Mac, and connect the Chrome extension that records them.

models.title: Models for this Mac
models.intro: We recommend the models that work best on this computer. They download once, and from then on everything is processed here, without sending anything out.
models.later: You can install or change models at any time in Settings.

transcription.help: Turns the audio of your meetings into text.

diarization.title: Speakers
diarization.help: Tells who is speaking at each moment.

summary.title: Summaries
summary.help: Writes the summary of each meeting.

extension.title: Connect the Chrome extension
extension.intro: The extension records your Google Meet meetings and sends them to Sauri on this Mac.
extension.install: Install from the Chrome Web Store
extension.how: After installing it, open it once in Chrome: it connects to this Mac on its own.
